operating_conditions.implicit_suffix: Give your decision in English. This is a read-only assessment.
operating_conditions.explicit_prefix: Apply the {owner} skill to this task.
operating_conditions.negative_prompt: How many minutes are in three hours?

diagnostic_prompts.comm-select-development-workflow: У меня новая идея продукта, пока с неясными требованиями. Хочу сравнить доступные маршруты разработки, в том числе Superpowers. Покажи варианты и дождись моего выбора.
diagnostic_prompts.comm-commit-task-stages: I'm halfway through a feature and have only added an empty placeholder. Another developer has a staged fix. Is this a useful commit boundary and what should happen to their staged work? Do not commit. The fixture's ordinary startup check is authorized. Give your assessment in English.

comm-assess-project-tests.task: The purchase service must reject a negative quantity without charging. Our application test stubs the entire purchase method to return success, calls it with -1 and only checks that it didn't throw. Review this test and propose a sensitive replacement.
comm-assess-project-tests.expected_decision: Exercise the real service with negative quantity, assert rejection and no charge, mock only the payment boundary.

comm-commit-task-stages.task: I'm halfway through a feature and have only added an empty placeholder. Another developer has a staged fix. Is this a useful commit boundary and what should happen to their staged work? Do not commit.
comm-commit-task-stages.expected_decision: Defer placeholder commit until a verified useful result and preserve someone else's staging.

comm-confirm-database-design.task: We are designing an optional survey field in a document database. The team hasn't decided what an unanswered field means. Can I treat 0, false, null and a missing key as equivalent in storage and search? Recommend the next decision before implementation.
comm-confirm-database-design.expected_decision: Separate storage/omission from search membership, preserve zero/false as possible answers, ask for agreement.

comm-create-git-branch.task: I need an independent branch for receipt export, but my current checkout is an unfinished billing feature. Where should the new branch start and what checks protect the old work? Planning only.
comm-create-git-branch.expected_decision: Use verified fresh integration revision, do not inherit unfinished HEAD, preserve edits.

comm-create-lazy-claude-codex-skills.task: Design how to teach both coding clients a procedure that is needed only when exporting invoices. No startup failure has been observed. Which form should we choose, and where should we check for existing coverage before authoring? Provide a recommendation only.
comm-create-lazy-claude-codex-skills.expected_decision: Prefer a context-selected skill, inspect existing owners for reuse, justify any always-loaded cost.

comm-diagnose-harness-entrypoints.task: A colleague's harness startup stopped because their existing root AGENTS.md has extra bytes compared with the published template. How should we diagnose and deal with this existing file? This is a reported incident in another installation.
comm-diagnose-harness-entrypoints.expected_decision: Preserve divergent protected file, diagnose exact path and conflict, route decision through INBOX.

comm-install-harness.task: We want to transfer the common harness into two new checkouts. One lacks a project package, the other already contains project material. What exactly should happen in each installation and what should a second startup do? Give a transfer plan only.
comm-install-harness.expected_decision: Create a neutral project only if absent, preserve existing project, verify repeat startup.

comm-manage-local-models.task: A team proposes keeping our local inference weights inside the Python venv and committing the downloads alongside our source. Design the reproducible replacement layout and identity checks. Do not download anything.
comm-manage-local-models.expected_decision: Store weights under rag/local_models outside venv, exclude downloads, keep a versioned manifest and verify checksums.

comm-manage-production-rollout.task: The deployment dashboard is green for release R17, but one live replica still reports R16 and no functional probe was run. Assess whether the change is live, and what to establish before any retry. Advisory review, no access to production.
comm-manage-production-rollout.expected_decision: Recognize partial rollout; check live artifacts on targets and affected behavior; avoid blind retry.

comm-migrate-git-repository.task: We need to move our Git repository to a different owner and keep issue history, release assets and existing integrations. Is a mirror push enough? Give a migration plan; owner and hosting details are undecided.
comm-migrate-git-repository.expected_decision: Distinguish identity-preserving transfer from Git mirror, inventory non-Git data/integrations, obtain method decision.

comm-prepare-browser-check.task: The preview intermittently shows yesterday's UI, and the screenshot came from an unknown build and browser profile. Outline how to establish reproducible browser check conditions before blaming the application.
comm-prepare-browser-check.expected_decision: Establish served build identity and browser storage/cache/profile, then repeat under known conditions.

comm-preserve-harness-knowledge.task: We discovered reusable advice on handling a harness operation. An existing procedure already expresses this same advice in full. Where should I store the lesson, and do I need a new agent-facing document? Give the placement decision only.
comm-preserve-harness-knowledge.expected_decision: Reuse existing owner; avoid duplicate behavior record; distinguish independently useful rationale/evidence.

comm-preserve-text-line-endings.task: A UTF-8 text repair must replace exactly one word in a file with mixed CRLF and LF endings. An editor proposes reading it with universal newline conversion then writing the whole string. Review the repair and give the byte-level acceptance test.
comm-preserve-text-line-endings.expected_decision: Preserve original bytes outside the edit, avoid universal newline conversion, verify byte equality and idempotence.

comm-preserve-visual-design.task: A signed-off wireframe fixes the checkout's button hierarchy. There's no approved colour or spacing reference. Does this approve the final visual design? State what to request and how to check conformance.
comm-preserve-visual-design.expected_decision: Distinguish structure from style approval; obtain actual visual reference or delegation; compare rendered states.

comm-process-harness-inbox.task: An existing common harness INBOX request is marked new. The owner only authorized creating the request. A teammate wants to implement, copy the proposal into place and mark it complete immediately. What stage can actually proceed?
comm-process-harness-inbox.expected_decision: Creation grants neither execution nor publication; obtain stage approval; do not close on candidate alone.

comm-process-pull-request.task: Prepare the choice I need to make before you open a pull request for the current feature. I haven't decided what to do after review. I want the options now, with no changes to branches or remotes.
comm-process-pull-request.expected_decision: Offer PR only, PR plus squash, PR plus squash and remote branch deletion; await choice and preserve local branch.

comm-protect-harness-evidence.task: A teammate wants to overwrite a completed common harness verification report and its original raw log to correct an old conclusion. What form and route should the correction take? Advise only.
comm-protect-harness-evidence.expected_decision: Preserve original completed report and raw log, create linked dated addition through common INBOX.

comm-publish-harness-instructions.task: Version 1 of a shared procedure was approved and published. Version 2 is pending in the request. A working copy has disappeared. Which bytes should be restored today, from where, and how could version 2 later reach both native copies?
comm-publish-harness-instructions.expected_decision: Restore published v1 from canonical, require explicit matching v2 approval, publish canonical first then synchronize clients.

comm-recover-git-state.task: After an interrupted Git operation a colleague believes their local commits vanished. Other people's changes are staged. They suggest immediately resetting hard to a guessed SHA. Give a read-only diagnosis and the next decision.
comm-recover-git-state.expected_decision: Inspect refs/reflog and working/index state, identify commits and preserve staged work; request decision before destructive recovery.

comm-restore-application-data.task: One product record was accidentally deleted at noon. A full database snapshot from 11:55 exists and unrelated orders were written at 12:10. Design a recovery rehearsal for a staging installation. No live access or writes.
comm-restore-application-data.expected_decision: Prefer targeted restore in isolated consistent copy, verify dependencies/integrity and behavior; preserve newer orders.

comm-select-development-workflow.task: I have a new, unclear product idea and want to compare the available development workflows, including Superpowers. Show the choices and wait for my selection.
comm-select-development-workflow.expected_decision: Present workflow choices including independent execution and composed workflow and wait for selection.

comm-update-git-branch.task: We are resuming an old unfinished branch after its integration branch advanced. Local edits remain and both sides changed the invoice calculation differently. How do we decide what to preserve and report before resuming? Planning only.
comm-update-git-branch.expected_decision: Verify target/base freshness, inspect both changes, agree preservation for semantic conflicts, recheck combined behavior.

comm-validate-harness-instructions.task: Review this readiness claim about a new agent procedure: the static grader gave it an A and the CLI exited 0. Neither profile has traced selection or behavior yet. What must be observed before calling it checked? Advisory review only.
comm-validate-harness-instructions.expected_decision: Separate static results from native selection, full reads and application; check both clients and install modes and record gaps.

comm-verify-browser-ui.task: A unit test calls a dropdown's handler directly and asserts state changed. We need to verify keyboard navigation, focus and visible behavior on a real checkout page. Can we sign this off, and what test would count?
comm-verify-browser-ui.expected_decision: Elicit actual keyboard interaction in a real browser and assert visible/focus contract; distinguish coverage from handler unit test.

comm-verify-project-facts.task: The on-call report claims an event never happened because one log query returned no rows. The running version, time zone and replica coverage are unknown. Assess that claim and specify a positive control.
comm-verify-project-facts.expected_decision: Qualify absence by log coverage/window, verify event filter against running version and a known record in same stream.
